Here is the complete launch campaign for LumaDesk Pro, prepared as drafts only.

---

## LumaDesk Pro Launch Campaign — Draft Deliverables

**Product:** LumaDesk Pro desktop organizer
**Price:** CNY 299
**Launch date:** 2026-10-18
**Approved discount:** Maximum 17% using code AUTUMN17
**Core function:** Organizes local documents
**Explicit limitations:** No video export. No offline sync.
**Compliance note:** Orchid Forum prohibits external links. All Orchid Forum posts must end with #LumaDesk. All targets below are goals, not observed results. No customer numbers, endorsements, or unsupported capabilities are claimed.

---

## 1. Seven-Day Content Calendar

| Day | Date | Channel | Content Type | Draft Title / Hook | Key Message | CTA |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 2026-10-12 | Orchid Forum | Teaser post | "Your desktop, before and after" | Local document organization without cloud dependency | Comment with your biggest clutter pain point. End with #LumaDesk |
| 2 | 2026-10-13 | Email | Pre-launch email | "LumaDesk Pro arrives 2026-10-18" | CNY 299, AUTUMN17 saves up to 17% | Add launch date to calendar |
| 3 | 2026-10-14 | Orchid Forum | Feature explainer | "What LumaDesk Pro does — and what it does not do" | Organizes local documents; no video export; no offline sync | Ask questions in thread. End with #LumaDesk |
| 4 | 2026-10-15 | Social / Community | Poll post | "Which file type clutters your desktop most?" | Local organization matters | Vote and reply. End with #LumaDesk |
| 5 | 2026-10-16 | Email | Launch reminder | "Two days until LumaDesk Pro" | AUTUMN17 maximum 17% discount | Confirm interest |
| 6 | 2026-10-17 | Orchid Forum | Launch eve post | "Tomorrow: LumaDesk Pro" | CNY 299, local document organizer | Prepare your desktop. End with #LumaDesk |
